files.author: Dennis G. Jarvis
files.caption: Best Western Vista Manor Lodge, Fort Bragg. Overlooking the Pacific, there's no shortage of superb scenery and a large beach across the road. Delight in the comforts of home - including a coffee maker, color satellite television with HBO, free high-speed Internet access and more - in each cozy, charming room at this Fort Bragg hotel.
